elements.label: Strength
elements.description: Flesh and bone quiver beneath the weight of the unnatural. Excess vitality courses through the veins, spilling out from the fingertips. The signs of strength are undeniable.

elements.label: Whimsy
elements.description: Inspiration kindles flame, and change follows.

elements.label: Revelation
elements.description: Clarity of mind like glass, thoughts swift as light—today, the Glory has bestowed its gift.

slots.label: Target
slots.description: Insert hidden enemies to reveal them, or insert a city for rapid reconnaissance.

elements.label: Twilight
elements.description: The faintest glimmer of possibility, foreshadowing the magnificent sunset yet to come.

elements.label: Innovation
elements.description: The starting point of every great creation.

elements.label: Enlightenment
elements.description: Understanding that something is necessary and inevitable, and facing it with confidence and composure.

elements.label: Grief
elements.description: Matters we dread to face, yet are powerless to change.

elements.label: Agonizing Wound
elements.description:
Some pains are so intense that they can bring about destruction even without physically existing. This pain could destroy me, but it will also destroy my enemies. 
[This counts as a wound. Sustaining three wounds of any kind at once will prove fatal. This cannot be refreshed by 'Work'.]

elements.label: A Wasteland
elements.description: No danger, nor any worth to speak of.

elements.label: Dawn
elements.description:
A new day, new possibilities. 
[Use this card during the Season of Past Stirrings along with a Desire card to change the game objective.]

elements.label: Noon
elements.description:
Still bright, but its former colors are no more. 
[Use this card during the Season of Past Stirrings along with a Desire card to change the game objective.]

elements.label: Sunset
elements.description:
The heat of light is most intense in the afternoon—though nightfall is not far off.
[Use this card during the Season of Past Stirrings along with a Desire card to change the game objective.]

elements.label: Night
elements.description: Night is cold, yet merciful: it promises darkness, silence, and concealment.

elements.label: Fog
elements.description: Heavy, misty fog provides concealment.

elements.label: Moonlight
elements.description: What is within, without; what is without, within. The Meniscate once gazed upon this place.

elements.label: Chill
elements.description: The cold of ice and snow stings the flesh, yet from it we may learn patience and silence.

elements.label: Gale
elements.description: A razor sharp gale sweeps away everything in its path.

elements.label: Rain
elements.description: The wound of the earth heals through this baptism.

elements.label: Flame
elements.description: Power shall find its release in its warm touch.

elements.label: Tide
elements.description: Ceaseless flow, endless devouring. Occasionally, a hint of coral-like scent slips through—ancient and faint—or perhaps it is merely illusion.

elements.label: Rumours
elements.description: Unverifiable rumours from which hard facts are impossible to glean. They could be hinting at some grander truth, but they're more likely just worthless speculation.

elements.label: Ys' Assistance
elements.description:
No craftsman could produce that extraordinary alloy, without the unique arts of Ys. 
[Use in 'Work' with the 'Forge Heart' to create Ys-alloy.]

elements.label: Opportunity: To Make A Kind of Special Ammunition?
elements.description: can command the craftsmen of this place to forge these specialized bullets for me, so long as I supply the necessary materials. [An opportunity to exchange Necessities for ammunition.]

slots.label: Necessities
slots.description: Place enough Necessities to complete the trade.

elements.label: Opportunity: Gunpowder From Adepts?
elements.description: I know of a few adepts who've stashed away some delightfully dangerous items in a secluded part of the district. They aren't usually willing to trade—but only a fool will turn down more practical supplies right now.[An opportunity to exchange Necessities for consumable.]

slots.label: Necessities
slots.description: Place enough Necessities to complete the trade.

elements.label: Opportunity: A Farm?
elements.description: The times may be tense, but farmers always try to keep extra supplies stocked—I can personally pay them a visit and help take inventory of their reserves. [An opportunity to get a few Necessities.]

elements.label: Opportunity: An Invigorating Preparation?
elements.description: A few Heart adepts here know the arts of preservation and ceaseless motion. Some hard currency would suffice to have them perform the work for me. [An opportunity to exchange Necessities for consumable.]

elements.description: A few Moth adepts here possess the craft of refining substances of chaos at midnight. Some hard currency would suffice to have them perform the work for me. [An opportunity to exchange Necessities for consumable.]

slots.label: Necessities

elements.description: A few Lantern adepts here know the arts of guiding Mansus-light. Some hard currency would suffice to have them perform the work for me. [An opportunity to exchange Necessities for consumable.]

slots.label: Necessities
slots.description: Place enough Necessities to complete the trade.

elements.label: Opportunity: Support From Royalists?
elements.description: It is no great task to rally my followers once more—I need only find the right words, then spare a little breath to speak them. [An opportunity to gain mundane support.]

slots.label: Ability
slots.description: Insert an appropriate ability to achieve alignment.

elements.label: Opportunity: Support From Army?
elements.description: A force loyal to me is garrisoned here. As long as necessary provisions are supplied, they will fight for me. [An opportunity to gain mundane support.]

slots.label: Necessities
slots.description: Place enough Necessities to complete the trade.

elements.label: Opportunity: Cajole Support From Army?
elements.description: An idle unit is temporarily stationed here. I could use a little trick to get them to fight for me. [An opportunity to gain mundane support.]

slots.label: Ability
slots.description: Insert an appropriate ability to achieve alignment.

slots.label: Opportunity
slots.description: Insert a condition conducive to achieving the objective.

elements.label: Opportunity: Potential Royalists?
elements.description: Though this land is remote and unfamiliar, there are still some notables here who could become my allies. [An opportunity to gain mundane support.]

slots.description: Insert an appropriate ability to achieve alignment.

elements.label: Opportunity: Seize Supplies?
elements.description: A shipment of precious wartime supplies was intercepted mid‑route by conflict and artillery. With just a little more time, they will all be mine.[An opportunity to get Necessities.]

elements.label: Opportunity: A Place to Rest?
elements.description: A quiet and secluded spot, where I can rest and regroup. Though it's nothing special, a chance to rest is especially precious given the circumstances. [An opportunity to refresh an ability.]

elements.label: Haunting Melodies
elements.description:
An ethereal, mellifluous tune that lingers in the mind. It also resembles the never-ending melody of Crossrow. Only, it is quite faint, as if coming from somewhere far, far away. 
[Seven of these will guide you to Crossrow.]

elements.label: Numa
elements.description: A cold, heavy mist seeps through every crevice. Between History and Eternity, ambiguous truths clash. In this season, the Hours' dominion over the Histories is at its weakest.

elements.label: The Watchman's Assistance
elements.description:
The Watchman is not compassionate; though we stand together, he will not heal or shelter me. But his light can burn away the obstacles in my path, or cleanse any impurities within me. 
[This can be used to remove certain negative effects, or refresh certain resources.]
